title: United Kingdom (starter profile)
note: Starter profile. Emergency numbers and emergency warning signs (transcribed from London Ambulance Service NHS Trust; examples, not exhaustive) are filled in. To be discussed and maintained by a community in this region.

emergency.message: If someone is seriously ill or injured and their life is at risk, call 999 now. 999 is for life-threatening emergencies like serious road traffic accidents, strokes and heart attacks. If you think you need urgent medical help and you are not sure whether to call 999, use NHS 111 (111 online, call 111, or the NHS App).
